doc: lesson 11 (#1384): the PRE-FIX shape — a local red whose record names no check (exactly what `.fleet/runner/local-green/<pr>-<sha>` held: {"rc": 1, "detail": "verify rc 1 (red); master was e996eb9534c9"}). The refusal must name that fact (`none-named`) and must NOT re-queue it: a red the runner itself ran is a verdict.
